In 2017, Ajja created an alternate version of his solo project under the name Junju, which focuses more on the groovy melodic sides of psychedelic trance with a more noticeable influence from old-school Goa trance.

In 2021, Ajja & Tanina Munchkina created the label Superfluid Sound as a place to gather all the unreleased music that Ajja has created over the years.

Ajja lives with his family in a quiet little village in the Swiss mountains. When he’s not busy touring or in the studio, he designs web applications, writes audio plugins in C++, paints and creates digital art.

Although he has regularly performed at major events around the world and is used to a heavy touring schedule, he still enjoys small, intimate parties and clubs just as much.

An energetic, enthusiastic and gifted being, Ajja is an artist not to be missed!

_UQqYlKOGEdWs5S28zx.name: Braincell
_UQqYlKOGEdWs5S28zx.description:
Having started in 1994 as a producer and DJ, Ralph founded the project Rastaliens together with his friend Jay. In 2003 he moved to Switzerland with his wife and decided to start his own project called ‚Braincell‘. His first album «Universal Language» was released in 2005, which was followed by an impressive string of releases on various compilations and major labels.
Since 2007 Ralph has also been producing tracks by the project name Solar Spectrum, which represents the more progressive side of his creativity. Solar Spectrum's debut album was released in 2009 and his second album (R)Evolution of Consciousness was released two years afterwards. The Reunion EP was released on BooM! Records in 2013 together with his 3rd album „Source Energy Creations“ (re-released on Ovnimoon Rec.) and 4th album „Droplets from the matrix“ (Ovnimoon Rec.) followed by several releases on various VAs and Labels. The 5th album „Divine Energy“ was released on Furthur Progressions Rec in December 2016.
In 2013 it was time for an Ambient/Chill/Downbeat project which was realized under the name ‚UNKNOWN REALITY“. Releases are available on unknownreality.bandcamp.com and the 2nd full length album is on the way as well. Last but not least there are several collaborations coming up with other artists from the international psy trance scene like „Melting Point“ (together with Earthspace) and „Driftsetters“ (with Maluns).
To date Ralph have been playing on every major continent; in countries like: USA, Brazil, Australia, Italy, Germany, UK, Greece, South Africa, India, Thailand etc. and received much praise for his energetic and emotional live shows, DJ sets and production skills.

7SIlTzYROVA6DDkmJQw.name: Dickster
7SIlTzYROVA6DDkmJQw.description:
Dickster, also known as Dick Trevor, also known as: The Green Nuns, Bumbling Loons, Circuit Breakers, Vogon 42, AAAH YEAH, Green Oms, AMD and many others.. is quite simply a force of trance nature.

Dicksters’ vibe is filled with the block-rocking love of funky complexity, mesmerizing detail, unstoppable movement and best of all… real psychedelic music!

Wt6frCrBcqU13kPoZw7.name: Martian Arts
Wt6frCrBcqU13kPoZw7.description:
Martian Arts is a BSc certified audio tech engineer and sound designer aficionado, that loves making psychedelic music using modular synths.

Has been releasing music under various projects, on various labels, including, TIP Records, Goa Productions, Zero1, Nano Records, Neurobiotic Records, Phantasm Records, Blue Hour Sounds.

Inspired by yesterday's riffs, pushing forward in new styles.

MWtbfOPnSRjGiUvGZlV.name: Purple Shapes
MWtbfOPnSRjGiUvGZlV.description:
Purple Shapes is a psychedelic trance project by George Tsafaridis, aka Nulla Taar & Ekahal and Fanis Dobros, aka DJ Wingman.

The project was created back in 2018 in Thessaloniki.
George and Fanis worked hard to produce something new inspired by various sub-genres of the psychedelic scene, which led them to produce their first EP “Alfheim & Niflheim” which was released in 2019. After performing in various events and festivals, gaining worldwide recognition by listeners and producers, they collaborated with many well known artists such as: Avalon, Laughing Buddha, Burn In Noise, KoxBox, Ingrained Instincts, DJantrix, NoFace & more.
In March 2022 they joined Sacred Technology and in June 2022 they released their debut album “Pendulum” which featured 11 brand new tracks which were produced from 2018 till 2022.

3olzEfqIbhQe4FUXdsn.name: Samadhi
3olzEfqIbhQe4FUXdsn.description:
Samadhi is a pioneering psytrance artist from St. Petersburg Russia one of the founders of famous Russian promo group Shanti Sound System and first radio show dedicated to psychedelic music in city called Shambala. He started djing since 1996 and producing his own music since the begging of new millennium.
His first releases were on legendary Russian labels De Ja Vu records and Vertigo records in 2004 – 2005. Then Ilya moved to live in Goa India after JAPAN tour for last few years and made a lot of gigs across Asia as well as many gigs around Europe in countries like Germany, Italy, Poland, Finland, Austria, Slovakia, Turkey, Estonia ,France , including big festivals like VooV 2009, Existance 2012 , SONICA in Italy , ODESSEY in Germany . Samadhi have released his split album with Fungus Funk on Blitz Studios and many tracks on compilations on important world labels like DISCOVALLEY REC, ACID DANCE REC, BOM SHANKAR REC, PURPLE HEXAGON RECORDS and many many more. Samadhi is also running a full power morning psytrance project thoghether with his goan friend Dj Nirmal called Trippy Trail. And freshly newest upcoming album from project with Chromatone – CHROMADHI

Ec5mmEhKBIhcB5Ius0O.name: SuperModule
Ec5mmEhKBIhcB5Ius0O.description:
UK based DJ and producer Lucas O'Brien has been rounding up dancefloors and rocking them in the right direction since he started playing acid house and techno in the early nineties at renowned London clubs such as The End, Heaven, Club UK and Fabric. His trance-infused psychedelic techno music was found to crossover with the sounds being played in Goa in the early 90s and it was this that led him to an opportunity to play at some of the early, now legendary, TIP parties.

With three highly acclaimed chart-topping albums ‘God Save The Machine’, ‘Tales Of Heads’ and his most recent album ‘Confessions of a SuperModule’ - under his new artist alias ‘SuperModule’ - Lucas is recognised as one of the world’s leading psytrance DJs representing Raja Ram's label TIP Records globally with his unique driving UK psychedelic sound.

Lucas has performed in over 45 different countries and shows no signs of slowing with his touring this year stretching as far afield as Europe, Russia, US, South America, Africa, Middle East, Asia and Australia. The same can be said for his studio productions with several exciting collaborations in the pipeline with artists such as Eat Static, Hallucinogen, Youth, Mechanimal, Earthspace, Illumination and a new project called "Mandelbrot" with Celli Earthling.

Known for setting dance floors alight with his diverse quality sounds and masterful mixing, he has become a firm favourite at prominent clubs and festivals worldwide.

G1rdJSeBZnOa38kj783.name: Tron
G1rdJSeBZnOa38kj783.description: Tron (real name Patricio Tron Piñero) is a legendary Mexican psychedelic trance producer and mastering engineer who has been a cornerstone of the global psy-scene for over two decades. Born in 1981 in Mexico City, he transitioned from a background in classical guitar to electronic music production around the year 2000.

wdhnH_egZgMPbuI0yf9.name: Athzira
wdhnH_egZgMPbuI0yf9.description:
Suseth Martinez, a visionary artist from Guatemala, has left an indelible impact on the music industry. Since 2014, she has pursued music production with unwavering passion.

In 2015, Suseth achieved a groundbreaking milestone as Guatemala's first female DJ in Hi-tech Psytrance. Performing as Cosmic Spiral, she captivated audiences and became an integral part of the esteemed FEEDBACK PRODUCTION GT Crew.

After three years of dedication, Suseth released her debut track under Voodoo Hoodoo Records in 2017. Signing with O.v.n.i Records, she introduced her innovative live act concept, Athzira, blending psytrance with indigenous music from Central and South America, inspired by Mayan culture.

In 2022, Suseth reached new heights with the collaborative masterpiece "Athzira and the Travellers." This marked the establishment of her record label, Ik-Tek Records, a testament to her visionary spirit and entrepreneurial drive.

Currently, Suseth explores new horizons with the Progressive/Full-on project "Aqua Aura" in collaboration with Hosenfeld. She diligently works on an anticipated EP for release on "Shamanic Tales Records," promising a captivating sonic journey.

Suseth Martinez's contributions have solidified her as a true trailblazer, consistently pushing boundaries in her craft. With international acclaim and unwavering dedication, she continues to captivate audiences worldwide, leaving an enduring imprint on music enthusiasts.

75-Ag0DfOxXvVNfh9yM.name: LunaRave
75-Ag0DfOxXvVNfh9yM.description:
Cosmos, travel, time and History, symbolic notions Lunarave wants to share through his musical universe. In 2004, within the Psynap's crew and later in 2006, on Hadra Records, Lunarave starts introducing his very own style and epic touch. After 2 successful albums on Hadra records, In 2012, he met Neokontrol and together founded OVNI Records Label, and release his 3rd album "Transmigration" out end of 2019, he's now working on the next chapter, as well as on side projects such as AngrY LunA, the hi-tech side project and his new epic series "Retro Future" or Amp Swamp , darkpsy/forest duo with Dark Elf aka Slate from Greece.
stay tuned and have taste of his latest production at his next appearance !

e9fXECO-a5i04YOby-X.name: Spirit Architect
e9fXECO-a5i04YOby-X.description:
Making music is about challenging your brain... becoming complex... being complex. Spirit Architect is a psychedelic trance act by Angel Zdravkovski from Skopje, Macedonia.

His first experiences with writing and producing music go back to 2003. After many years of experimentation and graduating as a sound engineer he was ready to let the world listen to the excellent productions. Many well received releases followed at Ovnimoon, BMSS and Geomagnetic Records. By the end of 2012 the project got noticed and signed by Dacru Records and many quality releases followed, accompanied by an 'anthology' full cd released at Ovnimoon records with some of the biggest hits, and an appearance on Armada Music in 2014. In 2017 the first proper full album ‘Moonshine’ was released at Dacru Records and turned out to be an instant hit coming in straight at #1 in Beatport’s psytrance releases and staying there for over 2 weeks. He’s also known for his cooperations with Djantrix and for his progressive side-project 'Dual Resonance', which is signed to Iono Music.

-qk6bfPqCsVAU1OyltA.name: Roja
-qk6bfPqCsVAU1OyltA.description:
Roja is the musical expression of Robin from Brussels, Belgium.

By melting his Rave influences with the Psytrance energy, he created his own vision of sound.
Powerful drops, driving basses and corrosive acid lines.

2p9c2wokOHgWNPH-Rmg.name: NoFace
2p9c2wokOHgWNPH-Rmg.description:
NoFace is the cutting-edge psytrance project by Lee Chizmario from Israel. The project was crafted in 2015 after Lee was exposed to psychedelic trance and immediately fell in love with the genre, the culture, and the universe this music represents. NoFace's musical style combines technological and melodic elements with high emotional energy, designed to take the listener to their peak. His stage performance is filled with high-octane energy, taking the crowd on a deep journey through sound and movement.


In 2017, after his first show in India, Lee returned home with a newfound musical vision, leading to his first EP release on BMSS Records. This initial success was played on dance floors worldwide by the leading artists of the genre, receiving incredible feedback from every corner.


At the beginning of 2018, NoFace joined the highly respected record label Sacred Technology, where he found a new home with people who understood his vision and helped him reach the next level. Under Sacred Technology, NoFace released the EP "Foundation of Reality," a groundbreaking step in NoFace's evolution. It was played around the world, particularly by DJ Thatha a.k.a Altruism at Boom Festival 2018, which immediately drew massive exposure to NoFace.


In recent years, NoFace has collaborated with and remixed some of the biggest artists in the global psytrance scene, such as Raja Ram, Electric Universe, Burn In Noise & Altruism, Outsiders, Sonic Species, and many more. NoFace has played at incredible festivals around the world, including Shankra, Own Spirit, Universo Parallelo, Antaris, Noisily, Apollo, Flor da Vida, Hipnotica, and many more.


Today, the NoFace project continues to evolve, conquering new territories and exploring the boundaries of psychedelic trance, pushing its limits to the max.

7_Vy_FIGgcwoImIP4EP.name: Nukleall
7_Vy_FIGgcwoImIP4EP.description: Nukleall, the guiding force behind Blacklite Records, is an established artist but also a luminary in the international Psytrance scene. As a label manager, his quality is exemplary, making him a formidable presence in the music discography. Without any doubts, his role as the director of Blacklite Records truly sets him apart. His vision and leadership have steered the group to oscillate at the pinnacle of the best psytrance labels, nurturing new talents, while still shaping the direction of the music style. Through countless parties and festivals, Nukleall has earned a reputation for his ability to transform tiny events into monumental experiences. Nukleall's musical creations are tailored for the dancefloor. His sound is a vibrant fusion of morning Psytrance, marked by a robust, groovy pulse and blended by psychedelic atmospheres! Nukleall's journey is one of globetrotting adventures. He has traversed the world, leaving his mark on dancefloors far and wide while meeting lots of new people and friends. With dedication to the music he loves, Nukleall is waiting to spread his sound and art worldwide, inviting all to join him!

SN4vtt7TB6L5dsId4wc.name: Adrenaline Rush
SN4vtt7TB6L5dsId4wc.description: Adrenaline Rush is the embodiment of raw energy and relentless beats. Born in the vibrant city of Lisbon, Portugal, he emerged as a Psytrance artist with an overwhelming presence that quickly conquered dancefloors around the world. For him, the stage is sacred ground, the dancefloor is a living canvas, and music is his most visceral form of expression. His performances are pure energy explosions — cathartic experiences where every drop is an invitation to collective ecstasy.

Tzx4GnAqT2LyLEmSO4L.name: Radikal Moodz
Tzx4GnAqT2LyLEmSO4L.description: Radikal Moodz is a Psytrance project created in 2017. With a taste for all types of psychedelic music, Radikal Moodz combines elements of Twilight, Forest and Dark Psytrance to create a unique sound that has gained popularity worldwide. In 2022, Radikal Moodz released his debut album, showcasing his versatility as a producer and performer. Radikal Moodz has played at numerous parties and festivals across the globe, captivating audiences with his high-energy sets and infectious beats. Radikal Moodz will continues to push the boundaries of Psytrance and explore new avenues of sound.

LdJn8TcuMUPylIMrndR.name: Gandhabba
LdJn8TcuMUPylIMrndR.description:
It was in 2000 that Manuel Batista began to deeply connect with music. Full of heavy tunes, from heavy metal to black, the love for music began, and the first connection to the music itself was when he began to learn guitar. Later in 2003, he “discovered” electronic music, Psy Trance, by going to his first open-air party. From that moment until now, his passion for electronic music has grown exponentially.

In 2005, he started playing DJ sets just for fun, but a couple of years later, with the love of mixing reaching a higher level, things became more serious, and he began to play in clubs, open-air parties, and bigger events.

In 2012, he started an advanced DJ degree that gave him a more refined and technical vision of electronic music theory and production. In the same year, in order to go further, he pursued an academic degree in electronic music and musical production and has since shared his time between production and mixing.

His set’s can take several paths and travel on the darker side of psy-trance or can follow more groovy psychedelic trails. The order is to simply innovate and improve, no matter what kind of music style. Without rules or limits.

qDxNAkaeG0-JOK-i3BF.name: Siloka
qDxNAkaeG0-JOK-i3BF.description:
France’s Siloka is a young promising producer with a great future ahead of him. Barely a year after falling in love with the welcoming psytrance community he found at Ozora, he was putting together tracks, improving steadily and quickly. Discipline and daily hard work paid off as he soon found his sound: a groovy bass with singing leads, a symphony of tweaks bustling happily. All leading to a crowd cheering for more in a dancing frenzy that feels like a never-ending dream.
Siloka knows how to make sure you’ll find yourself in a field of smiles, surrounded by friends old and new, brought together by music you never imagined, but Siloka did.
The party is only beginning, surprises are coming.

wTiOw7c6gizmQTPz6_z.name: Wubba Lubba
wTiOw7c6gizmQTPz6_z.description: Wubba Lubba, the latest signing of the legendary label HOMmega Productions, is the new musical adventure of well-established psytrance artists Shivatree (Ilan Fleischman from Israel) and Imaginarium (Nikola Gasic from Serbia) and as you can already guess, their music doesn't sound minimal or progressive. After many years of friendship and love for the same kind of music (and other nonsense), they started to explore different realms of psychedelic sound and create trippy night tunes in faster bpm, to bring distinctive music, different from their solo projects. They recorded this DJ mix right after they released their debut EP 'Shaym Aliens' earlier this month. It's assembled mostly from their original unreleased music and it's a good introduction of the Wubba Lubba sound.

UyVErVqu3JgsuCNZxMU.name: Stryker
UyVErVqu3JgsuCNZxMU.description:
Stryker music is a solid mix of Psychedelic Trance, Full-on, Electro with a twist of Tech.

Barthelemy Bayona better known by his stage name Stryker, is a French international Psychedelic trance music DJ, engineer and producer. He is one of the most prominent artists from the French scene. Combining more than 20 years of career in the music industry, Stryker is the outcome of all this experience from the production angle as well as from the musical side. The result is a fat crystal clear production bound by no codes, always exploring and fine tuning every single track. And it’s all about making the people dance and
smile!

His tracks have reached the top of the charts many times, collaborating with artists such as Talamasca, GMS, Space Tribe, Sonic Species, Mad Maxx, Pixel, Mekkanikka and many more. As a DJ/Producer, Stryker always deliver such a positive experience on the dancefloor at any time of the day and in many events anywhere on the planet. Bart is managing his time very tightly, between being the mastering engineer of many of the top artists and labels, touring and producing with no compromise in the music and during his performances.

Constantly delivering a flow of hits and concepts, the last one being a versus album with the legendary GMS.
Keeping in mind the need to explore uncharted territories, Stryker just teamed up with his pal Mekkanikka to create a new genre of electronic music with their soon to be announced project “WIKIDZ”!

z4c34MbfC_UOZ8W52zF.name: Hyriderz
z4c34MbfC_UOZ8W52zF.description: Behind the Hyriderz project is Benjamin Callard, a French-Caribbean producer which has always been attracted by arts and particularly electronic music at a very early age. He discovered Psychedelic Trance during his time living in Paris adopting very quickly the vibe of the music and the scene. He started Djing at that time and moved very fast to learn how to produce his own music. An incredible inspiration came true when he returned to his born island, being closer to Nature & Spirituality provided by this living Paradise. The will of putting his music out to the world become an evidence. Moving towards groovier, fatter and tribal sound, Hyriderz was born as an already mature Progressive Trance project. He made his debuts in 2014 and released on many labels of the psytrance scene like Electronic Dope, Hadra, Yellow Sunshine Exposure, Expo and Tweaked Records. He is today in the United Beats Records family and Smart Booking Agency. The future of Hyriderz is promising, with more incredible music & collaborations. His debut album is planned for 2018. Stay tuned as you’ll get blown away by this new talent!

M-J-UTCEcduR1ldqQxm.name: Zeridium
M-J-UTCEcduR1ldqQxm.description:
Zeridium is the Psychedelic Trance project of Joan, a French producer from Toulouse. His journey began in 2009 at a Goa party on Anjuna Beach — a spark that ignited his lifelong passion for psytrance.

After five years of world travel and deep inspiration from global cultures, he returned to France to channel his experiences into sound — giving birth to Zeridium.

Signed in 2017 to Sahman Records, one of France’s top psytrance labels, Zeridium has built a strong reputation for high-energy, cutting-edge productions. Blending analog warmth with digital precision, his tracks — usually around 148–150 BPM — fuse groovy basslines, acid with high resonance, metallic FM synths, and dark psychedelic textures to create a powerful, immersive experience.

ybj0prbyZtRbqgnHq-z.name: Render
ybj0prbyZtRbqgnHq-z.description:
Render is the psytrance project by Ricky Casero.
Born into a family of classical
musicians, Ricky has been practicing and performing since he was 5
years old. His talent and commitment took him around the globe,
joining orchestras as horn soloist.
Around 2010 Ricky started exploring the magical realms of psychedelic
music through his classical eye and realized how psychedelia is
connected to his previous studies.
His first project Frequency Less was born in 2011 resulting in a
intelligent Psybreaks and downtempo music production.
In 2015 he launched his psytrance project Render to start practicing his
skills on more powerful beats.
His unique style is a mix of passionate body moving fullon, wisely
blended with night atmospheres and rolling bass lines. Unexpected
combinations of catchy vocals and acid funky sounds make the journey
super energetic and fluid for the dancer, without missing the soul and
essence of the psytrance self-exploring experience.

zyj8k2ALSUNp8sAqdHE.name: Overdrive
zyj8k2ALSUNp8sAqdHE.description:
The man behind the project is Gonçalo Malosso from Portugal, an experienced producer and sound engineer currently residing in London, UK. Overdrive is the culmination of more than a decade of studio production where he went through several artist aliases until he found his balance point. His music is characterized by intelligent design and high quality sound, a deep fat bassline and driving stories that are taking dancefloors worldwide to the next level. The fully charged music is the result of a deep melodic background supported by a driving psychedelic sound combining the best of both worlds into a unique sound experience, that is gaining fast recognition among the public with his powerful live performances and top ranked releases.

2017 was a year of many surprises with the official launch of the project and international performances, Including the acclaimed UK festival BoomTown. A debut EP and featured tracks on the Uncharted series at Dacru Records, led up to joining this leading label on a long term basis. After which he also compiled a volume in the Uncharted series himself. You can expect an array of releases coming as the project is reaching peak productivity.

mQIT6JO2Qq2B_-w3UKN.name: Anthill
mQIT6JO2Qq2B_-w3UKN.description: Band members: Ognen Zafirovski (Yudhisthira) & Darko Toromanoski (Kala)

YvzzqAwqRJFe3rRItGX.name: Kabayun
YvzzqAwqRJFe3rRItGX.description:
Kabayun is a psytrance producer from the United States. After spending many years honing his sound, performing around the USA, and organizing parties in New York City, David has spent the last 5 years touring the globe, performing in many European cities, in North and Central America, Asia, India and Australia, and at many of the top summer festivals in Europe, including Ozora, MoDem, Antaris, Summer and many more....

After releasing his debut album on 2to6 Records in 2011, in 2012 David joined the team at Looney Moon Records, based in Italy. In 2015 he joined Sangoma Records, a label based in Germany that promotes psytrance without genre boundaries, which is a perfect fit for his music, which floats in the border zone between twilight, forest, and dark, pulling elements from each, for a full power, psychedelic and very danceable vibe.

His tracks have been featured on many compilations and releases from top psytrance labels over the years, currently David is working on a ton of new music, including a new EP and an upcoming album on Sangoma Records, as well as many collaborations with some of his favorite artists and friends in the scene.

Now residing in Philadelphia, PA, USA, Kabayun is available for bookings worldwide.

Kabayun’s music intends to create an environment that stimulates the listener to release themselves from the trials of everyday life and confront their challenges through the trance dance experience. Channeling the spirit of the west, Kabayun pulls together many elements to create an intensely psychedelic experience that lifts the body and the mind to undiscovered plateaus….

JO5s-fGaUf9b48gDnNY.name: Antonymous
JO5s-fGaUf9b48gDnNY.description: Antonymous is an artist based in Athens, Greece. and exploration of various harmonium keyboards at a private conservatory. In the early 2000s, he discovered a passion for psytrance.

2rT8lRbo9LGiFfuO3Ua.name: Cosinus
2rT8lRbo9LGiFfuO3Ua.description: Cosinus was born in Germany 1979 and currently living in Biel, Switzerland. Michael discovered the world of electronic music at the age of 13 and was inspired by artist like Yello, Kraftwerk and the sounds of Detroit techno and house music. His first steps in his DJ career started behind a pair of turntables at a local youth club in his hometown. After 20 years of rocking dancefloors with his energetic sets he put his focus now on his own musical creations that he plays in his livesets (and occasional DJ sets). Cosinus is signed to Sangoma Records and released tracks on labels such as Woodog Records, Macky Mad House Records, Subsystem Records,Forestdelic Records to name just a few. In 2015 he released his first EP “Mudulated Frequencies” and compiled Ironic Creatures and Ironic Cultures with DJ Izzy on Sangoma. So far he played in Germany, Austria, USA, Switzerland and the Netherlands. His sound can be described as epic pumping, jumping and snarling forest psytrance – a fusion between nighttime psychedelic and deep forest friendly atmospheres. His story fits perfectly to the early hours of the morning as well as the middle of the night – powerful music to tune on heads. An artist that shouldn’t be missed at any party.

aFf2STe9KcKah3o_ZyI.name: Delytic
aFf2STe9KcKah3o_ZyI.description: Delytic is a musical artist, primarily known as a vocalist/featured artist in the psytrance and electronic music scene, collaborating with producers like Kabayun on tracks like "Molecular Clouds" and "Escape Velocity," known for atmospheric, cosmic-themed sounds on labels like Parvati Records and Sangoma Records, appearing on Spotify and Bandcamp as a featured voice.

TnnTXJdaALsz_bwgwyF.name: Farebi Jalebi
TnnTXJdaALsz_bwgwyF.description: Farebi Jalebi has spent over a decade producing and playing his own brand of psychedelic music at parties and festivals around the globe. Since 2010, Farebi has been on the roster of the legendary Parvati Records and ever since, he has been developing a flavour of his own. His music is characterised by thick and bouncy bass-lines, deep and melodic scapes and funky grooves. Each track tells its own peculiar tale with plenty of drama and emotions, and together they morph into sets that take listeners into unknown realms.

dsXqg6A9ehoF7v4q6Je.name: Ingrained Instincts
dsXqg6A9ehoF7v4q6Je.description:
Ingrained Instincts is a unique project consisting of Tilemachos Vlachos, and Dafy Deliangelos from Greece. Both have shared the same passion for Psychedelic music since their very early days. They met in 2001, formed a project together, and started to develop a different sound, but one totally sympathetic to the scene, and yet wholly psychedelic, and funky!

After many years of experimentation, the Ingrained Instincts project was born in 2014. Their sound could be described as an amalgamation of many variations which don’t fit in one box – definitely different and organic sounding. For their production they use analogue as well as digital hardware, and are building their own modular system. Tilemachos also has a downtempo project called “Escape Velocity”, with releases on Spiral Trax, Sonic Loom and Eardream Music amongst other labels. Ingrained Instincts are signed with Sangoma Records and so far released on TIP Records, Nano Records, Future Music Records, Blacklite Records and more. Ingrained Instincts have been busy touring around the globe and have performed live at some of the biggest festivals of the Psytrance scene such as Boom, Ozora, Universo Paralello, Sonica, Antaris, FreeEarth, Indian Spirit, Kosmos and many others…

This is one project you have to keep an ear out for, because before you know it you’ll be dancing away. Uncontrollably! It’s infectious.

5MbE3ROQiBpJmadQiv8.name: Ninesense
5MbE3ROQiBpJmadQiv8.description:
Ninesense is the psytrance project of Nuno Cabral, raised in the Azores Islands.

His love for psychedelic music began with a Goa cassette gift, sparking years of dedication to mixing and production. In 2015, Nuno launched Ninesense, releasing his debut album Spectrum in 2016. Known for its versatility, his music spans daytime psychedelia to nighttime forest psytrance, leading listeners on an imaginative journey.

In 2017, he founded Reversible Records, continuing to share his sound with audiences worldwide – and beyond.

cr3kZHk_GN4GRNuvKWY.name: Virtual Light
cr3kZHk_GN4GRNuvKWY.description: Virtual Light is a psytrance producer and DJ hailing from the great white North of Canada. He has been slaying dance floors like it was 1999 since 1999 and has toured the world many times over, laying down his signature sound at all the world's top festivals. Being one of the Zero1 label DJs, his style ranges from futuristic twilight to a deep, uplifting, classically psytrance vibe unified by an enigmatic character that defines the Zero1 sound.

cv3XwPepAID8ckhzcxy.name: Vertical
cv3XwPepAID8ckhzcxy.description:
Vertical is the internationally established psytrance project of Joonas Lehtinen from Finland. The project saw daylight around 2007 and after few years of working on the sound and sending demos, he caught the interest of Giuseppe from Parvati Records. This was a big turning point in Joonas' life and with the new motivation he started to work on more material for his track repertoire.

Soon after his debut appearance on a Parvati compilation in 2009 he played his first gig outside Finland in Marseille (France) in the new year 2010. With the help of Parvati Records and guest appearances on other Labels he started to get more bookings in many legendary events and to grow a bigger fanbase in the scene.

During the past years he has performed across Europe, Brazil, Japan, India and USA from club events to big festivals (Boom Festival, Ozora, Hadra, Modem and Soulvision to name just a few).

Vertical music is known for it's wide spectrum of styles and moods, never really staying in one formula but aiming to push the boundaries of psytrance with his signature sound and new ideas.

5KrZHOqfFus9fu0JLwn.name: raft
5KrZHOqfFus9fu0JLwn.description: raft is a Swedish occult rock band founded in 2000.

43H-uRVzYsAT2SYnNjK.name: Yab Yum
43H-uRVzYsAT2SYnNjK.description: Yab Yum is an electronic music project that was founded in 2004 by Ajja S.F. Leu & Gaspard Besson.

SGHcV1l0g01anOZ46MQ.name: Junju
SGHcV1l0g01anOZ46MQ.description:
Junju is a solo project created by Ajja S.F. Leu in 2017.

Focusing mainly on 140 bpm psychedelic trance with an uplifting flavor, Junju is heavily inspired by Ajja’s teenage years in Goa during the early evolution of the psychedelic music scene.

X0mQFlT6sdTGRNRCE6x.name: Ovnimoon
X0mQFlT6sdTGRNRCE6x.description:
Chilean Producer/Dj
Label Manger on Ovnimoon Records
Ovnimoon ( Progressive Psytrance / Goa Trance / Chill out )
The Key ( Progressive Psytrance )
HedustMA ( TechTrance / Dark techno )
OM ( Ambient Drone - Yoga music )
3 Access & You ( Club Trance )
Ovnimoon & Rigel ( progressive Psytrance )
Ohrusvuda ( Glitch Hop )
Stuardo ( TechHouse - Electro )

6hRKEhBhH9F__U7iRsp.name: Killerwatts
6hRKEhBhH9F__U7iRsp.description:
Tristan + Avalon = Killerwatts

Tristan and Avalon are two heavyweight Nano Trance masters who combined forces in 2010(??) to become Killerwatts. Between them they have headlined most of the major Psychedelic festivals and clubs across the globe with their solo acts and now Killerwatts is joining the ranks. With two top charting albums under its belt, ‘Edge Of Time’ and ‘Blow Your Mind’ (which was remixed by the very best artists in the scene to create ‘Blow Your Mind -The Remixes), as well as several successful collaborations, they have a live set that rivals the very best; with their awesome UK Psychedelic Full-On sound that never fails to set the dance floor on fire.
What started as a side-project of two legendary Psytrance producers, Killerwatts is now a fully-fledged phenomenon in its own right that stands shoulder to shoulder with the biggest names and is now constantly touring the world spreading its unique brand of Killerwatts Power.

VoZ5hr6puNcN9Ve5uCv.name: Tripswitch
VoZ5hr6puNcN9Ve5uCv.description: Nick Brennan’s 18-year career as Tripswitch has seen numerous successes and highlights, from New York Times reviews to BBC Radio 1 airplay, live performances all over the world, writing music for a major video game, ad campaigns, music for BBC’s Blue Planet – and more recently, the veteran Chillout-Electronica “producer’s producer” has consolidated his rising position in the Progressive House world through a massively busy few years of original productions, remixes, DJ performances, and collaborations with some of the biggest names in the business, including his old friend Nick Warren and most recently El Maestro, Hernan Cattaneo.

Bj0tK88PaKdXFh14cKn.name: Burn In Noise
Bj0tK88PaKdXFh14cKn.description:
Gustavo Manfroni, the creative force behind Burn in Noise, has been immersed in music from a young age. A lifelong guitarist and member of two rock bands, his musical journey took a huge turn during a trip to London, where he first encountered psychedelic trance.

This experience ignited a deep passion for electronic music, and by the end of 1999, Gustavo began refining his production techniques, embracing the limitless potential of digital music creation.

With a distinct sound defined by powerful, warm basslines and intricate, psychedelic leads, Burn in Noise stands apart from conventional full-on Psytrance. His music pushes the boundaries of the genre, offering a fresh and innovative direction for the dancefloor.

Over the years, Gustavo has earned a reputation as one of the top live acts in the global electronic music scene. Performing in more than 40 countries, he played at prestigious festivals such as Boom Festival (Portugal), Ozora Festival (Hungary), Universo Paralello (Brazil), Fusion Festival (Germany), and many others.

His performances at these renowned festivals, alongside eight albums and over 350 releases on top labels globally, highlight his expertise and lasting impact on the psychedelic trance movement.

Burn in Noise’s music transports listeners to the origins of psytrance, while preparing them for new sonic adventures that transcend the limits of consciousness. Ready yourself for the ride.

y6LGrGyVuDDQPb4c82i.name: Electric Universe
y6LGrGyVuDDQPb4c82i.description:
Berlin based musician, Boris Blenn, is the innovative mind behind the internationally acclaimed 'Electric Universe' project. Boris has been active in the global electronic dance music scene since the early 90th and is considered by many as one of the pioneers of Goa Trance the parent genre of what later became Psy Trance.

Throughout the decades the Electric Universe brand has matured and grown bigger, attracting large audiences and fans all over the world. Unlike many old time projects the Electric Universe brand has always kept relevant and transformed perfectly and constantly impacted over time. The discography of Electric Universe is long and wide and includes some of the greatest hits of all times on both Goa Trance & Psy Trance genre's charts.

Throughout time Electric Universe has delivered constantly one hit after the other which led to a big fan base throughout the world and especially during the digital media revolution on all its platforms. The exceptional music abilities and innovative production skills on both analog and digital platforms has led Boris to various musical production & projects on both underground and high end commercial scenes.

The Electric Universe project live show is in high demand and practically led Boris to perform on pretty much all of the respected and most demanding stages in the world. Among those stages one should note: Tomorrowland Festival (Belgium), Boom Festival (Portugal), Ozora Festival (Hungary), Universo Parallelo (Brasil), Neverland Festival (Israel), Earthcore Festival (Australia), OMMIX Festival (Mexico), Arcadia Festival (Japan) to name the immediate few.

Electric Universe is constantly evolving and constantly adapting new technological advances, embracing them and making them great. After his first encounter with the LaserHarp instrument back in 2015, Boris was left with a decision to one day to incorporate the instrument in his shows.

In 2017 with the development of the new Phase7 Laserharp Instrument the work on this special project begun. In 2020 this concert will be officially launched after two successful testing at Indian Spirit Festival 2018 & 2019 in Germany. In the year 2018 Boris launches a new, special podcast titled 'Psycast', a special recording taken on the road from some of the amazing psychedelic trance locations Electric Universe visits, shedding like into the specific country and scene.

Ri1N-jefJDXIcHCW1dJ.name: Ace Ventura
Ri1N-jefJDXIcHCW1dJ.description:
A true force in the Psytrance world and beyond it, Yoni Oshrat, better known as Ace Ventura, isn't just a DJ and producer - he's an experience. For over two decades, his infectious energy has ignited dance floors worldwide. From intimate clubs to headlining major festivals, Ace Ventura has captivated audiences with his signature style. His music is characterised by a fusion of hard, pumping dancefloor oriented themes and deeper, groovier influences, always immersed in psychedelia.

As a DJ his diverse musical tastes and vast musical knowledge enables him to create unique sonic experiences. In times when lineups consist mostly of short producer sets, Yoni pushes the envelope to play long sets that tell a real story, going back to the origins of DJ culture.

His passion for psytrance extends far beyond music. Alongside Liquid Soul, he co-founded Psy-Nation, a global movement encompassing a monthly radio show/podcast and a travelling party line. This dedication to the genre fosters community and discovery for psytrance enthusiasts everywhere.

While psytrance is his domain, Ace Ventura's musical curiosity extends to downtempo and dub universes. This deep appreciation for diverse electronic styles adds another layer to his artistry, evident in his acclaimed "Ace Ventura in Dub" sets.

Beyond his solo ventures, Yoni also collaborates on successful projects like Alpha Portal (with Astrix), Alien Art (with Captain Hook), Liquid Ace (with Liquid Soul), and Acid Punks (with Outsiders), each project offering a different sound adventure.

CZ9_dFT-LIyBwU2zpEo.name: Raja Ram
CZ9_dFT-LIyBwU2zpEo.description:
Raja Ram (born Ronald Gary Rothfield, 18 December 1940) is an Australian-born musician and the owner of the United Kingdom record label Tip World. He was a founding member of the psychedelic rock band Quintessence in the late 1960s and early 1970s, playing at the first two Glastonbury Fayres in 1970 and 1971. He later found success in the psychedelic trance scene and continues to headline at large events worldwide.


Raja Ram performing with 1200 Micrograms in Teotihuacán, Mexico, in September 2009
Ram was nominated for "Best Psychedelic Trance DJ" at the DJ Awards in 2001 and 2003.

VHbmWlrJVIRtvqAJ6-Z.name: Sitarsonic
VHbmWlrJVIRtvqAJ6-Z.description:
SITARSONIC is a fusion project of Electronica, Mantra & live Sitar by Paco Rodriguez (FR).
Paco started learning sitar in 1994 in Varanasi (India), the same year he was initiated to the sacred mantra “Om Namah Shivaya” by his Tantric yoga teacher, and never stopped practicing since. He passed two years in the Himalayas with the Naga Babas of the Das Nami family, and lived 9 years in a Buddhist commune in the French Pyrennees. He first visited Goa in 1993, and has been living there on and off since.

SITARSONIC enjoys a close relationship with the Psychedelic Trance movement. He twice played Ozora Fest (Hungry 2015/2022), and his opening performances at Atman Fest (Portugal 2023), Parvati Stage in Free Earth Fest (Greece 2019) and Harmonic Fest (France 2015) have been hailed as memorable magic experiences. His collaborations with major artists of the scene such as Electric Universe, Dark Elf, Volcano on Mars and Kaya Project have brought the mystic sound of his sitar to dance floors all over the planet.

In 2022 SITARSONIC released his 9th self-produced album “Downloading The Coconuts”, on the French label WP Satellite. It’s an instrumental project of 6 long tracks which explores diverse horizons of Electronica, Ambient, Dub or Chill out, featuring another collaboration with Electric Universe, “Dub Stanza”, previously released on Sacred Technology.

Paco also leads KIrtan sessions and provides Soundscaping with his sitar in retreats and yoga centers in India and Europe.
His side project, the psychedelic band Kundalini Airport became a legend in Goa with their famous Cosmic Jam, and is still very active...20 years now!
 
Performing psychedelic Electronica everywhere from cafés to festivals, SITARSONIC is currently based between Anjuna (Goa, India) and Matala (Crete, Greece).

08AF7wp79wDS7taQDqv.name: AlTarba
08AF7wp79wDS7taQDqv.description:
Al’Tarba is unclassifiable. As he is a joyful mess, writers who might want to do his biography would get lost as easily as Alice in her rabbit hole, even though the Toulousain is only 28.
Almost 10-year career, 5 albums and 2 EPs, many featuring, Al’Tarba is not a beginner anymore. Often true, statements about this hyperactive artist are only fragmented if we accept that they are.

To summarize: Coming from a family of music lovers, it is not surprising that he had his first band as a rapper as he was only in primary school. Then, when puberty hits, he will turn himself into Punk music, listening bands like Damned, the New-York Dolls or The Ramones. When he is out with his friends, Al’Tarba is glued to his skateboard, his ears full of Rancid or NOFX
At this time he met his future mates from Droogz Brigade. With them, Al’Tarba will discover Mobb Deep, Necro, or Wu Tang and will change his role as a (bad) bassist in a punk band to some solo experimentation, East Coast Style.
From there, alongside the musical walk with this always-curious tune-lover, he will be considered as pure hip hop beatmaker, dark, almost Horrocore as Necro or Stoupe would be.
To some people, he will be a great funky electro-swing composer, like Chinese Man, with the success of Mushroom Burger, Petite Maline or Sexy Coccinelle. As he is growing, so is his music, resulting in a flying abstract hip-hop as RJD2 or DJ Shadow..
Far from the beatmaker under influences, Al'Tarba devotes himself to be a solo artist claiming the complexity and abandoning the label of "purist" too often related to punk or hip-hop.

He is the creator of a whimsical, grandiose, sometimes ridiculous world where cartoons, genre films, comics gore, beautiful ladies and gangsters meet. In his world childhood‘s candor converges with violence and the adulthood’s ill-being.

The real world becomes a dreamlike vision with the track Let the Ghosts Sing. Conductor of a joyfully funeral ball, Al’Tarba is playing with piano, glockenspiel and guitar or trumpet organic sounds echo’s back by abstract beats and electro patch.

The album is filled with voices like a ghost whispering in our ears. Vaporous, the sampled voices never truly reveal themselves, and we’re not even sure if we heard them in the first place. At other times, the ghost take human form with the Tsigane singer Paloma Pradal from Bonnie Li, Jessica Fitoussi or the reggae girl Dantisa.

Let the Ghosts Sing could be the soundtrack for a Tim Burton movie, as we feel joy surrounded by death. Siberian Vengeance or Still Insomniac take us to a trip inside our own mind when Gangster & Rude Girls or My Vicious Side work as a carthasis, as we headbang our troubles away. That’s the strength of Al’Tarba and this opus, they bring us to an imaginary place where we face the nostalgia and spookiness of our childhood, while enjoying it as an adult.

Yj1VWoESoHtJyZnF5rM.name: Sator Arepo
Yj1VWoESoHtJyZnF5rM.description:
SATOR AREPO tenet opera rotas.... an perpetual constancy of the circular motion of the cosmic order.

The project was founded in early 2006 by Dominik H. from Munich. Dominik always had a deep connection to music, being heavily influenced during his adolescence by genres such as Metal and Punk Rock, he later on started his first steps in music production and began to experiment with different styles from Hip Hop to Breakbeat. Due to his former day job, as a event engineer, he coincidentally made contact with the Psychedelic-Trance scene, what in retrospective, turned out as a game changer in his life. Since that point, he focussed passionately in creating his idea and interpretation of deep & powerful nighttime Psytrance, never afraid to explore the limits and push the boundaries in terms of style and sounddesign.

Sator Arepo's music nowadays is a sonic rollercoaster, which characteristics are ranging from groovy and mental attitudes up to hard hitting, dancefloor focussed soundscapes. Productionwise, he's always trying to improve his skills ,in order to constantly shape and reinvent his style. With rising popularity in the global Psytrance scene, he released during the last years on welknown labels such as Deviant Force Rec, Sonic Loom, Parvati Rec, Sangoma Rec, Discovalley Rec, Lycantrop Rec, Avatar Rec and many more. Besides his solo works, he is a lively collaborator and active in several projects like:

- Cracked Nozes with Rawar/Lurker on Deviant Force Records & Sangoma Records
- ChromArepo with Chromatec on Deviant Force Records
- Haunted Spectre with Silent Horror on Deviant Force Records

His live performances made him a frequent musical globetrotter, playing some of the most important festivals the scene has to offer like Ozora, Universo Paralello, MoDem , Masters of Puppets, Karacus Marakus, Pulsar Festival, Freqs of Nature, Hadra Festival, Hive Festival , and many more.

In addition to being on stage, he's also taking duties in the background of the scene, as one of the founders of the infamous underground label Deviant Force Records and the co - founder and organizer of the party series Mental Intrusion.

5r1DiPY3xOnGBiYcozG.name: Art Materials
5r1DiPY3xOnGBiYcozG.description:
Art Materials is the uprising headlining Artist / Producer couple Kaylee and Robert, better known by their aliases KAYLEE and Suspect One - they are also the forces behind Modular Festival which speaks for their relevance and contribution to the international Psytrance scene - representing the spirit of future. Art Materials exclusively signed with Looney Moon Records resulting from their massive success of their debut collaboration entering Charts straight to # No.1 on beatport Psytrance Top100. Together with their good friend ‚Jumpstreet‘ , Art Materials the 3 swiss joind forces and proof to have found the next generation formula to bring their subgenre ‚twilight/nightpsy‘ to whole new levels.

This talented pair is known for their immersive and energetic dark and fast psytrance grooves with their signature technoid structure given by their Techno background, that are guaranteed to get you moving and keep you dancing all night long. With their unique sound and captivating energy, Art Materials is a standout talent on the electronic music scene. Don't miss your chance to see them in action and let their music transport you to another realm. Get ready to lose yourself in the beats of Art Materials!

f8ObDMDLJABcmVrVpSr.name: Dr Fractal
f8ObDMDLJABcmVrVpSr.description:
Dr Fractal is a psytrance project that has evolved over the years through the exploration of different musical paths, both within electronic music and beyond. A musician since childhood and a drummer in different bands, he gradually discovered the wide spectrum of electronic genres, moving through dub, drum’n’bass, techno, and falling in love with psytrance.
His music stands out because he’s always chosen to swim against the tide, drawing inspiration from what he listens to without ever trying to replicate it. Instead, he’s developed a personal sound marked by deep and immersive atmospheres, sharp and powerful beats, and a sought-after sound design. The result is a rich and evocative sonic identity.
Rather than following trends or fitting into predefined molds, Dr Fractal aims above all to offer a unique auditory experience—one that resonates both physically and emotionally.

XcKXf9D6d9vphLHhECz.name: Jumpstreet
XcKXf9D6d9vphLHhECz.description: Jumpstreet is the psytrance project from swiss producer Raffael Willi. Growing up playing musical instruments and composing tracks at an early age he finally found his way to electronic music production with no limits to creative musical expression. In 2015 he joined the italian label Looney Moon Records and further progressed his unique style with milestone releases Nanodroppin' and Gourmet Noise. His music is rich in variety of sounddesign while always keeping a funky vibe that keeps the dancefloor moving. Over the years Jumpstreet has been heard on dancefloors all over the world, and on famous stages like Ozora and Boom Festival.

BN0eJeXqWKqxWm7sYk7.name: Jirah
BN0eJeXqWKqxWm7sYk7.description:
Tim Jirah is a Psychedelic Trance artist and DJ based in Denver, USA. He has been DJing and producing psytrance since 1997. He released his first album «Outer Access» on USTA Records in 2003 and soon after began to gain global popularity. In his 25+ year career he has worked with many well-known labels in the scene and has worked with artists such as E11even, Spectra Sonics, Virtual Light, Zephirus Kane, Chromatone, Earthling, Random, Tron, Spiritual Mode, Magnus, …and has shared stages with Jumpstreet, Spectra Sonics, Sonic Species, Daksinamurti, Deedrah, S-Range, Ticon, …and many others!

Aside from music production, Tim has also worked as a sound designer for Zenhiser samples, producing 15 psytrance sample and preset packs to date.

BIdiV2MeygXwMXcv9NA.name: Justin Chaos
BIdiV2MeygXwMXcv9NA.description:
Justo Burgues is a seasoned producer and purveyor of nighttime psychedelic music, known for his projects ShaperZ and DJ Justin Chaos. Since 2011, Justo has played a pivotal role in the world-renowned *Ozora Festival*, curating its international lineup and helping shape the festival’s iconic nighttime sound, making it one of the best places to experience cutting-edge psychedelic music.

After several years of contributing to the festival’s success, Justo shifted his focus to music production, though he still maintains an advisory role at Ozora. His DJ sets are what truly set him apart, keeping him in high demand and touring across the globe. Rarely at home in his chosen city of Buenos Aires, Justo often spends time in Goa at the start of each year, playing at venues like Shiva Valley.

An integral member of the Zero One Music and Bom Shanka Music families, Justo plays a key role as label coordinator and manager, working tirelessly with the artists and helping grow both labels into internationally recognised forces within the psychedelic scene.

eqpIXf5pAIjhli9OOl8.name: Zephirus Kane
eqpIXf5pAIjhli9OOl8.description: ZK has been producing Psy Trance since 2010. First as the duo Master Blasters, and since 2017 has established himself as the solo artist Zephirus Kane. He plays at top Psy Trance events such as Boom, Ozora, Universo Paralello, Mundo De Oz, Shankra, Origin, Odysee, Sonica, Glastonbury, Green Magic, HillTop, Shiva Valley, Transition, and many more around the world. He has collaborated with psy masters Ajja, Tristan, Dickster, Sonic Species, Virtual Light, Tron, Mandala, Martian Arts, Ital, Hypnoise, Hypatia and more. ZK has been on a musical journey since he first sat behind a drum kit at the age of 12 and has been working with sound ever since. He has scaled the highest levels of the pro audio industry mixing live sound for artists such as Grace Jones, Ed Sheeran, David Guetta, Morcheeba, Rudimental, Craig David, Dizzee Rascal and many more.

1F4whD4WXIIy88gCa1n.name: Imaginarium
1F4whD4WXIIy88gCa1n.description:
Imaginarium is a cutting-edge psytrance project known for its unique fusion of psychedelic soundscapes and innovative electronic music. Founded by Serbian producer Nikola Gasic, Imaginarium has carved out a distinctive niche in the global psytrance scene.

Nikola, born and raised in Belgrade, Serbia, developed a passion for electronic music at a young age. His early forays into music production led him to explore various electronic genres, but it was psytrance that truly captivated his creative spirit.

Launched in 2014, Imaginarium quickly gained attention for its dynamic arrangements, characterized by hypnotic rhythms, layered melodies, and immersive soundscapes. The project’s music often blends traditional psytrance elements with modern production techniques, creating a sound that is both familiar and refreshingly original.

Live performances are a significant aspect of Imaginarium’s appeal. Known for his dynamic and engaging sets, Gasic has performed at major psytrance festivals around the world. His shows are celebrated for their high energy and the ability to connect with audiences

Imaginarium's music is available on major streaming platforms, and Nikola remains dedicated to producing innovative psytrance that challenges listeners and transcends the ordinary. With a growing global fanbase and a reputation for solid sound and production, Imaginarium continues to be a force in the psytrance world, constantly evolving and redefining the possibilities of psychedelic music.

kvdj5QW7hYmT4rGQHes.name: Ital
kvdj5QW7hYmT4rGQHes.description:
Chilean Psytrance Artists since the year 2001
still blasting the high vibrations through the spiritual music

LXPqfSV0uJnvwDFR7bg.name: Dezzert
LXPqfSV0uJnvwDFR7bg.description:
Luciano Rolón, also known as Dezzert, was born on July 12, 1997, in Buenos Aires, Argentina. His journey into Psychedelic Trance began in late 2012, at age 15, exploring various styles and tempos within the genre. Inspired by leading DJs and producers, he launched his music career in 2016, with a focus on the Night/Twilight style. His music is packed with high energy and surreal, unexpected timbres.

In February 2020, he debuted with his first EP, Overlay Textures, on the SquareLab Music label. In May 2021, he released his first LP, Spread the Word, and followed up with a second EP, Created for You, all on SquareLab. Dezzert has since performed at major festivals, including Mundo de Oz 10 Years, Xyryry Kuaray, Apollo28, Naturaíz, and Modem Festival.

Prepare for new adventures and mind-expanding journeys with each of his tracks releasing now with his new home, Reversible Records.

uamxPJO3Bdt33bRmHjy.name: Creepy Deep
uamxPJO3Bdt33bRmHjy.description:
Creepy Deep is the project developed by Marco Paulo Calixto, from Brasília. Who brings serious and original tracks, with the aim of keeping the dancefloor in maximum euphoria.

Fast and psychedelic synths, involved in deep ambiences, always combined with powerful basslines are hallmarks of the project that collects releases on some of the major labels on the genre.

Wo6H5i2bRsNACD1OCkf.name: GMS
Wo6H5i2bRsNACD1OCkf.description:
GMS (also known as the Growling Mad Scientists) are a Dutch psychedelic trance duo which have attained significant popularity, beginning in the early 1990s. Formed by Shajahan Matkin (also known as Riktam) and Joseph Quinteros (also known as Bansi) in the city of Amsterdam, located in the west of The Netherlands, the duo has attracted a large international fanbase. GMS founded Spun Records in 1999, the first psychedelic trance label in the United States and Ibiza, Spain.

In 2008, GMS left Spun Records to further concentrate on their own careers and had created in 2009 a new label to release all of their music from their own various bands called Starbox Music.

They have sold over 350,000 copies worldwide. Director Tony Scott used GMS tracks in his films Man on Fire, Domino and Unstoppable.

GMS won the Psy-Trance award twice (in 2001 and 2009) at the DJ Awards in Ibiza, Spain.

NIbPqdXf8U16xZ2DVrR.name: Undefined Behavior
NIbPqdXf8U16xZ2DVrR.description:
Undefined Behavior is the brand new project of two well-known and loved names of today’s psychedelic scene: Ajja & Burn In Noise.

Expect the unexpected as this power combo is sure to take you on a unique trip down the rabbit hole of psychedelia!

1BgWpDfDllU6gUCD1bH.name: Tristan
1BgWpDfDllU6gUCD1bH.description:
Tristan Cooke (born 1970), is a British psytrance and Goa trance DJ and producer.

After graduating from Warwick University, he travelled throughout India playing at Full Moon parties in Goa, before returning to the UK in 1993 swiftly establishing his name on the London trance scene at events such as Return to the Source, as well on the emerging outdoor trance party circuit.

uDpoGMcNm04S94nPSeF.name: Circuit Breakers
uDpoGMcNm04S94nPSeF.description:
Circuit Breakers is the acid drenched cohesion of two massive Psytrance artists; Dickster (UK) and Burn in Noise (Brazil).
They have been sending dance floors into a frenzy with their energy-filled deep psychedelic sets around the world for many years now, and are festival favourites at all the best psychedelic events.

lKcVrB9Cpfmg8ygJwOm.name: Shivatree
lKcVrB9Cpfmg8ygJwOm.description: Shivatree is a psychedelic trance project founded in 2013. by Ilan Fleischman (aka DJ Cholo) from Israel. His style is a fusion of powerful bass lines & a massive rolling melodies involving influence drawn from the old school Goa trance days but still keeping in lines with current techniques of massive sound designing. Shivatree is already playing string of massive gigs at some of the biggest dance floors and festivals all around the globe. Shivatree is ready to take over the scene with a massive storm.

k1ak0wYG04arnRWSJP2.name: Altruism
k1ak0wYG04arnRWSJP2.description: Thatha is much loved on the global psytrance scene and has performed as a DJ and as a Live Act as ‘Altruism’ at all of the best festivals and clubs around the world, with the demand for her sets ever in demand. Always classy, Thatha & her ‘Altruism’ sets are mixed with a lot of harmony and versatility allied to a great technical ability, and she is always able to take the dancefloor where she wants with her charm and light.

pKh9SbbeBBTXMTaXyJf.name: Avalon
pKh9SbbeBBTXMTaXyJf.description:
Avalon is one of the leading and most in-demand artists in the Psy-Trance scene today and for over a decade one of the top headliners at most major psychedelic trance events around the globe and has worked with Tristan, Ajja, Vini Vici, Astrix, Burn In Noise, Ace Ventura to name a few.

Avalon has had 15 Psy-Trance number 1 hit’s on Beatport and five number 1 selling albums, he has also released another 5 albums with his collaboration projects (3 albums as 'Killerwatts; with DJ Tristan and one album with Sonic Species under his progressive alias ‘Future Frequency’, 1 album as 'RealityGrid' with E.V.P ) which have also garnered mass appeal.

His non-stop world wide touring schedule has seen him playing at the biggest events including, Ozora, Boom, EDC Las Vegas & Orlando, Glastonbury, Tomorrowland, Burning Man, Tribe, Dreamstate, Exit festival, Sunburn, Ultra, Universo Parallelo, Tribe, Rainbow Serpent, Enchanted Valley Carnival, ASOT, Symbiosis, Atmosphere, Ministry of Sound, Time and Space, Xxxperience, BAT, Antaris, Freedom, Origin, and the list goes on. Avalon is signed to the legendary Nano records, but also has released on major labels such as spinnin records.

pKhGSGLeBfsXMTaXyJf.name: Aum Shanti
pKhGSGLeBfsXMTaXyJf.description:
Aum Shanti is the project created by André Firoozabadi.
Already from childhood music played a big role in his life. During his years he has been playing various instruments with the lead guitar as his main tool. This tool soon became the turn tables.

With his deep passion for psychedelic music, he fell in love with the world of psychedelic trance. Soon he began to tweak his own sounds.
With a mission to spread the healing vibes of the sacred geometry, you can always expect lots of love, passion and good vibes.

1dJCJeeHKZzl8jpcbR5.name: Mekkanikka
1dJCJeeHKZzl8jpcbR5.description:
Nicolas Oesch (A.K.A. Nikka) is the musical creator behind the psytrance project called MEKKANIKKA. He has been producing and releasing psytrance music since 1999.

MEKKANIKKA released his first solo album on Germany’s legendary psytrance label, Spirit Zone in 2004. Receiving instantly great response from international dance floors, leading him to launch an international career and release much more music

MEKKANIKKA has since then become an established name in the trance scene. He is well known for his crystal clear music production and his high energy live performance. He has been delivering sets all around the world sharing the stage and/or the studio with numerous psytrance artists …including GMS, SPACE TRIBE, SONIC SPIECES, AVALON, MAD TRIBE, STRYKER, MAD MAXX, AJJA, BLISS, MICHELE ADAMSON, SPONGLE, RAJA RAM, TRISTAN, EARTHLINK, TALAMASCA, and many more. On the creative side, MEKKANIKKA has been releasing music consistently, many time reaching the top of the charts.

The 2019-2020 season will be full of new high end music and performances, as he just teamed up with his good friend STRYKER to start a new wild project called “WIKIDZ” to be launched in the spring 2020. Get ready to embark on a musically charged experience.

XToqrC5bFpqZINGnDOH.name: Bare Up
XToqrC5bFpqZINGnDOH.description:
Daniel Harwood, known as Bare Up, is a British drum and bass producer and DJ originating from Devon, UK. His musical journey began at the age of 13 when he explored FL Studio, inspired by electronic remixes of rock classics such as Muse’s Knights of Cydonia. This early experimentation shaped his path toward a career in electronic music, eventually carving out a space for himself within the drum and bass genre.

Bare Up achieved his first major breakthrough with Pull Up, a jump-up track that became a defining anthem at Rampage 2018, catapulting him into the limelight. Since then, he has released standout tracks like Can't Stop through Sigma’s BeatsBassLife imprint and the Turn Up The Dimensions EP on Born On Road, showcasing his ability to blend high-energy jump-up with elements of neurofunk. His collaboration with Rampage Recordings further solidified his position as an artist to watch.

Known for his innovative approach to production, Bare Up has gained support from leading names in the drum and bass community. His music frequently appears on platforms such as Beatport and Spotify, and his work with respected labels, including Born On Road and Rampage Recordings, has contributed to his growing influence within the scene.

As a live performer, Bare Up has captivated audiences at high-profile events, including Tomorrowland, Rampage Open Air, and We Are Electric. His dynamic sets, which seamlessly blend various subgenres of drum and bass, have earned him a reputation as a thrilling act on the festival circuit. Bare Up continues to push the boundaries of his craft, influencing the genre and inspiring upcoming artists in the global drum and bass community.

s5gavOu4eXb6ilRxqvc.name: Don Diablo
s5gavOu4eXb6ilRxqvc.description:
Don Pepijn Schipper (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈdɔn pəˈpɛin ˈsxɪpər]; born 27 February 1980), better known by his stage name Don Diablo, is a Dutch DJ, digital artist, record producer, musician and songwriter of electronic dance music. He is one of the pioneers of the future house genre and was ranked sixth in the Top 100 DJs – 2020 list by DJ Mag. He was also ranked number one Producer of the Year for 2018 by 1001Tracklists. In 2016, he was ranked the number one Future House Artist of the Year on Beatport.

In 2015, he founded his own record label, HEXAGON.

ShOu5fcYGsOVCZlIElA.name: Mind Vortex
ShOu5fcYGsOVCZlIElA.description:
Sometimes all it takes is one tune. One tune and that’s it: your life will never be the same again. For schoolmates Laurie Carroll and Stefan Anfield is was Resonant Evil’s Renegade Hardware 2003 classic ‘Troubleshoot’. The second they heard those haunted chords and sneering, snarling bassline they knew drum & bass was going to be a major force in their life. The shamanic state it left them in even influenced their name: Mind Vortex.

Classically trained musicians, Laurie on the clarinet and saxophone, Stef on the piano, the pair both dropped out of their jazz bands the following day. Picking up old bits of hardware and whatever software they could afford, the duo spent the following six years chiselling their craft. Soaking up influences far and wide; soul, jazz, funk and classical were all added to the menu as the pair munched through music, digging deep to understand what made certain tracks so powerful and all the best hooks come with that tangible sense of magic.

2009: research and development over, they were confident they had a sound sharp enough to unleash. They wrote a wishlist of labels they wanted to work with. Ram was top of that list, so they picked up the phone.

The rest is D&B history! Ram instantly recognised Laurie and Stefan’s talents and, after a debut on Plush Recordings, signed them exclusively. ‘Now It’s Time’ and ‘Onslaught’ were the first signs of Mind Vortex’s presence on Ram. Debuted on Andy C’s critically acclaimed ‘Nightlife 5’ mix, they instantly reflected the duos understanding of the wider extremities of drum & bass science. While ‘Now It’s Time’ showed a knack for funky hooks and well executed vocal work, ‘Onslaught’ proved the pair had just as much knowledge of the darkside with its unrelenting bass texture and cunning sense of classical drama.

Their debut Ram single ‘Hotbox’ followed and quickly cemented them as one of drum & bass’s most exciting new acts. Whipping up bonafide hype from January 2012 onward, it dominated the drum & bass charts at both BBC 1Xtra and Beatport, gradually tearing a hole out of the entire year. Still widely regarded by many DJs as one of THE tunes of the year, it struck the perfect balance of vibrant, chart-alluring hooks and outrageously raucous bottom end. Naturally the year ended with a fitting climax; their slamming mix on Ram’s Drum & Bass Annual 2012 went straight to number one in the iTunes dance chart.

With fans such as Zane Lowe, Mistajam, Grooverider, Bailey, Crissy Criss, DJ Hype and Drumsound and weekly DJ appearances across Europe, Australia and the US, Mind Vortex remain hot property as we look into the future. 2013 will see more exciting new material including new single ‘Alive / Arc’; yet another devastating double header that exemplifies their wide range as producers, ‘Alive’ is rare moment of song-written drum & bass beauty while ‘Arc’ slams us back into the same bass-bashed casualties that ‘Hotbox’ caused.And there’s plenty more to follow. With a water-tight production regime, no time is wasted between the duo; both know when it’s right for the other to take the lead as they bounce exciting ideas back and forth until they’re honed and polished to production perfection, And ready to influence the next generation. Just like Resonant Evil did with them exactly 10 years ago.

BMwC8oam2Oy4J1e8deq.name: Feint
BMwC8oam2Oy4J1e8deq.description: Andrew Hu, known professionally as Feint, is a British Drum & Bass producer and DJ, who debuted on Monstercat with his track Atlas, which was released on July 9, 2011.

dBx7Y5fkXcskFvXv4Hu.name: CoMa
dBx7Y5fkXcskFvXv4Hu.description: CoMa is an artist who debuted on Monstercat as the featured vocalist on the song Supercool! by Stephen Walking, which was released on November 28, 2011.

OVlYm6R4qYkC0gFqXZt.name: Laura Brehm
OVlYm6R4qYkC0gFqXZt.description: Laura Brehm is an American London-based songstress. In the world of electronic music, she has worked with a vast array of producers and labels while maintaining introspective and innovative songwriting. Her journey began as a classically trained pianist, but it was through singing and acoustic guitar that she truly found her creative voice. Alongside collaborations, Laura continues to develop her solo project, drawing inspiration from a unique blend of folk, country, rock, alternative, and pop. With an extensive overall catalog accumulating more than a billion streams, Laura remains ever-evolving. She views her musical path as a lifelong endeavour; pushing boundaries, refining her artistry, and always striving to explore new sonic landscapes and reach greater heights.

eZOVwDF90cosizBDKxX.name: Boyinaband
eZOVwDF90cosizBDKxX.description:
David Paul Brown (born 24 August 1987), also known by his pseudonym Boyinaband, is an English musician, songwriter, rapper, and YouTuber. Brown is known for his song "Don't Stay in School" and collaborations with other YouTubers such as iDubbbz, Roomie, Andrew Huang, TheOdd1sOut, Jaiden Animations, Emma Blackery, Dan Bull, Corpse Husband, and PewDiePie. His work spans various genres including electronic, hip hop and heavy metal as a producer, vocalist, rapper, songwriter, DJ and instrumentalist.

Among other endeavors are his former electronicore band You and What Army, with whom he won the Red Bull Bedroom Jam in 2010 and toured alongside Kids in Glass Houses.

pvAgk7SUGc2bSS2wBMC.name: Veela
pvAgk7SUGc2bSS2wBMC.description: Veela is a Canadian singer, songwriter and producer. She debuted on Monstercat as the featured artist on the song Time Bomb by Feint and Boyinaband, which was released on April 18, 2012.

JHBsPgXmY9inBU45pjN.name: Fox Stevenson
JHBsPgXmY9inBU45pjN.description: Stanley Stevenson-Byrne (born 25 January 1993), better known by his stage name Fox Stevenson (formerly Stan SB / Stan SSB), is an English singer-songwriter, DJ and producer of bass music, mostly drum and bass and glitch hop. He has released two albums and eleven EPs under Fox Stevenson, one under Stan SB, and has been featured on two compilations under Stan SB and eighteen under the name of Fox Stevenson.

43HmTWQNnGajS1M5o6Q.name: Kanine
43HmTWQNnGajS1M5o6Q.description: Supported by some of the biggest and most influential names in Drum & Bass, the young Londoner known as Kanine has risen to new heights in recent years with a long career shaping ahead of him. Originally recognised as one of the leading names in the new wave of Drum & Bass producers, his sound is evolving all the time as he moves towards being one of the more versatile artists in the 174 BPM range.

tlD6X5ETivtUQp9SXvz.name: Muzzy
tlD6X5ETivtUQp9SXvz.description: Mustafa Alobaidi (born 10 November 1994), better known by his stage name Muzz (formerly Muzzy, stylised in all caps), is an English drum and bass producer and DJ. He first gained attention with his release on UKF, "X No Way Out" in 2010 and continues to release music, most predominantly on Monstercat. He has also worked with other labels, such as UKF Music and Liquicity.

0jqVrH2C4qIAvao5Jkb.description: Jack Mirror, previously known as Priority One, is a drum & bass artist who debuted on Monstercat with his and NCT's remix of the song Feeling Stronger by MUZZ, featuring Charlotte Colley, which was released on June 29, 2015.

UcWX8msY7l4S32Jvgea.description:
Hailing from the enchanting city of Salzburg, RageMode, also known as Christoph Wall, has embarked on a relentless journey to redefine electronic music. Starting as a BassHouse DJ in 2016, RageMode quickly captured the scene’s attention, amassing over 10 million streams and performing solo shows all over Europe.

Nevertheless, it was the influential internship with Mefjus during his university years in 2021 that ignited his unwavering passion for Drum and Bass.

The year 2022 saw him take the stage as a pure Drum and Bass act for the first time, captivating Austrian audiences with his electrifying performances.

In 2023, Christoph made a decisive shift, fully embracing Drum and Bass as his genre of choice. Not long after, a pivotal moment in his career arrived with the debut of an official remix for Camo & Krooked, which premiered on UKF and has since amassed over a million streams.

He solidified his position as a prominent drum and bass producer even further by skillfully crafting one of the opening tracks for that year’s Let It Roll Festival.
From his formative years in BassHouse to his current reign in Drum and Bass, RageMode’s sonic evolution continues to unabashedly push boundaries,making an enduring impression on the vibrant electronic music scene.
